### 下载 · Download

Download **`Cameo-<version>-macOS-Universal.dmg`** from Assets below — macOS 14+, Apple silicon and Intel.

1. 打开 `.dmg`，把 **Cameo** 拖进 **Applications（应用程序）**。Open the `.dmg` and drag **Cameo** into **Applications**.
2. 第一次打开会被拦下：**系统设置 › 隐私与安全性 › 仍要打开**。On first launch: **System Settings › Privacy & Security › Open Anyway**.
3. 菜单栏出现 Cameo 图标，Chaofei 开始在屏幕底部溜达。Chaofei starts wandering along the bottom of your screen.

`checksums.txt` lists the SHA-256 of each download.
